name: Sinaida Krivchenko
tagline: New media artist. Interactive projections & stage visuals. Prague-based, working globally.
bio: Sinaida Krivchenko is a Prague-based new media artist building living visual systems for stages and physical spaces — real-time TouchDesigner and GLSL work, interactive projections, and audio-reactive visuals for live performance. Trained as a biomedical engineer (MSc, Bauman Moscow State Technical University), with prior careers in IT leadership at General Electric and creative direction for cultural institutions in Amsterdam. Works with performing-arts organisations, musicians, festivals, and cultural institutions.
services: Stage and projection design — real-time generative environments for live performance, built in TouchDesigner and GLSL
Audio-reactive concert visuals — full visual sets for live music, one look per song, driven live by the sound
Interactive and immersive installations — body- and gesture-tracked visual systems (MediaPipe, WebGL) for exhibitions and physical spaces
Generative AI visual direction — campaign imagery, key art, and production visuals directed to the specific aesthetic of each project
Creative direction for cultural institutions — visual identity, digital infrastructure, and audience strategy
